name: feat-2874
title: #2874 — every tool shows that it is working, and the indicator keeps moving (PR, port 5174)

cases.title: 3-D: a slow line shows «חושב…» with a turning ring, from Enter until the figure appears
cases.lookFor: Type the three lines. On the third («|SA| = 5», about 2–4 seconds): from the moment you press Enter the «הוסף» button is grey, reads «חושב…», and the small ring beside the word KEEPS TURNING the whole time, until the figure is redrawn. Then press «הציגו תצורה אחרת»: now that button itself is grey and reads «חושב…» with the turning ring, until the figure changes.
cases.before: The page freezes for 2–4 seconds with nothing on it changing: no «חושב…», no motion.
cases._probe: motion probe 2026-11-13, PR port: «|SA| = 5» kept the page thread busy 2.2 s; 125 screencast frames arrived inside that stretch, 123 distinct images of the button (the ring turning). «הציגו תצורה אחרת»: 2.2 s busy, 123 frames, 120 distinct. On main: 0 frames in the same stretch.

cases.title: 2-D: «בטל» pressed while a file is still loading waits for the load, then undoes it
cases.lookFor: A RULING IS NEEDED HERE. Type the line. Press «טען» and choose src/__tests__/fixtures/hexagon-regular-by-angles-2797.geo.json (it loads for about 8 seconds, «חושב…» with the ring). WHILE it still says «חושב…», press «בטל». On this build the press waits its turn: the hexagon appears, and then the undo takes it back, so you end on the triangle ABC. Is that what «בטל» should do during a load?
cases.before: On prod the same press runs at once: the triangle disappears while the file is still loading, and you end on the hexagon.
cases._probe: probe 2026-11-13: main ends on the 10 hexagon rows (the undo removed the triangle at once); the PR ends on «משולש ABC» (the undo ran after the load and undid it). The driver cannot choose a file, so it only builds the triangle.

cases.title: 3-D: turning a row off and on, and «הציגו תצורה אחרת», on the slow figure
cases.lookFor: Un-ticking row 3 is quick. Ticking it again takes about 2 seconds, and for all of it «הוסף» reads «חושב…» with the ring; the three rows are there at the end. «הציגו תצורה אחרת» shows «חושב…» on its own button.
cases.before: Each of these froze the page for about 2 seconds with nothing shown.
cases._probe: timeline probe: re-enable 2.2 s, edit «|SA| = 6» 2.2 s, «הציגו תצורה אחרת» 2.2 s — «חושב…» and the mark on screen from 14–50 ms after the press until the figure; no page error.

cases.title: 3-D: an ordinary figure builds exactly as before
cases.lookFor: The cube and M on the edge BB′, both rows green. The button blinks «חושב…» for a moment on each line, no longer than 2-D does on its own lines.
cases.before: unchanged (a regression guard); the blink is new in 3-D.
cases._probe: timeline probe: each fast action shows «חושב…» for 65–70 ms (2-D submit on main: 110–125 ms).

cases.title: 3-D: a wrong claim is still refused, with the same sentence
cases.lookFor: The second line is refused: «הטענה לא מתקיימת בציור — בדקו את החישוב»; one row only, and the line stays in the box.
cases.before: unchanged (a regression guard).

cases.title: 3-D: «החלף בין A ל-B» typed in the box swaps the letters
cases.lookFor: The row now reads «קובייה BACD», and the two letters have changed places on the figure.
cases.before: unchanged (a regression guard): the swap now runs as a job on the queue.
cases._probe: probe: the canvas letter popover on main and on the PR give the same rows — rename A→K «קובייה KBCD», the taken letter C quotes its holder and offers the swap, the swap gives «קובייה KCBD».

cases.title: 3-D: a line typed while the tool is still working stays in the box
cases.lookFor: Un-tick row 3 and tick it again; while «חושב…» shows (about 2 seconds) type «M אמצע AB» and press Enter. Enter is off while the tool works: the line stays in the box, and a second Enter after «חושב…» is gone adds it.
cases.before: The page was frozen and showed nothing; the Enter was taken when it thawed, and the line was added.
cases._probe: probe 2026-11-13: main ends with 4 rows and an empty box; the PR ends with 3 rows and «M אמצע AB» in the box. This is ADR-W-198 (Enter off while «חושב…») reaching every action, as ADR-W-210 states it.

lines: מרחק נקודה O מהצלע DA הוא √5

cases.before: The page froze for 8–12 seconds per line with nothing shown.
cases._probe: motion probe: «x_A > 0» kept the page thread busy 11.8 s; 702 screencast frames inside it, 681 distinct images of the button.
